notes: Indigo.ca is a bookstore-first Shopify site; scoped strictly to the non-book 'Lifestyle' (Home/Gifts) side per task instruction, excluding books/stationery-office/toys. Checked: (1) robots.txt - standard Shopify boilerplate, no Claude-specific disallow. (2) Full header/mega-menu nav crawled programmatically (242 unique links) - every 'Bestsellers'-labeled nav item (Fiction Bestsellers, Non-Fiction Bestsellers, Canadian Bestsellers, Kids Bestsellers, New Bestsellers, Globe and Mail Bestsellers, NYT Bestsellers) is book-department only; the Home/Lifestyle mega-menu group (Water Bottles, Candles, Mugs, Home Decor, Entertaining) has NO bestsellers/popular/trending child link of its own. (3) Full collections sitemap fetched (3 shards, 7294 collection URLs total) and keyword-filtered for bestseller/top-seller/popular/trending/favorite - no Home-scoped hit besides 'trending-gifts'. (4) Probed ~15 guessed Home-scoped handles via products.json (lifestyle-bestsellers, home-decor-bestsellers, indigo-lifestyle-bestsellers, bestselling-lifestyle, bestselling-gifts, bestselling-home-decor, top-sellers-lifestyle, popular-lifestyle, popular-gifts, trending-home-decor, gifts-bestsellers, most-popular-gifts, customer-favourites, customer-favorites-lifestyle) - all returned 0 products (non-existent). (5) 'this-week-in-search' (nav text 'Trending on Indigo.ca') returned 0 products via products.json - empty/not a real listing, and is site-wide (not Home-specific) even if populated, so excluded either way. Found one genuine candidate: 'Trending Gifts' (/collections/trending-gifts), matching the brief's 'Trending Products' target term exactly. It is NOT currently linked in the live site nav (discovered via sitemap) but is a real, live, populated collection page (own H1/title, own item count). Its 34 products are a cross-department gift mix (mugs, candles, tumblers, a pillow, bookends, journals, a hat) - dominantly Home/Lifestyle merchandise with a few stationery-adjacent items - so it is flagged for scope review rather than silently dropped, since Indigo has no purely Home-exclusive Bestsellers/Trending PLP. ACCESS: tier-1 plain curl hit a Cloudflare managed-challenge/429 after rapid sequential probing (not a permanent bot-block); escalated immediately to tier-2 Playwright, which passed cleanly by loading the homepage first to establish a session, then reused that session for all subsequent fetches - no Claude-in-Chrome (tier-3) needed. Only one row emitted, so no duplicate-link risk within this file.
